title: Scan to Comprehend
summary: Audit dense pages with source, assistive, raw-versus-rendered robot visibility, retrieval, attention, and page-basics views from one browser capture or HTML prototype.
author: TriunaLabs
origin: Original TriunaLabs workflow developed from a user-supplied Scan-to-Comprehend concept and Triuna Labs blueprint, checked against primary NN/g eye-tracking, visual-attention, and W3C sources. No third-party code or datasets are included.
requirements: Python 3.10+ for optional source audit and HTML report; Pillow for the attention baseline. The optional assistive capture needs Node, Playwright, and Chrome or bundled Chromium; public URL capture needs network access. The local MCP adapter requires integrations/requirements-mcp.txt. The optional orchestrated OTLP trace export needs observability/requirements.txt and an explicitly configured endpoint. The optional section probe requires a browser with Pointer Events and explicit host activation. Rendered and reader validation requires suitable tools and participants.
examples: Restructure this technical article so a reader can find the conclusion quickly and still inspect the methods.
Review this product page for readers comparing plans on a phone; show the top comprehension barriers.
Turn this high-density dataset into an infographic with a clear takeaway, readable comparisons, and a text equivalent.

preview.alt: Three linked reading stages: orient, locate, and understand, with headings and context.
